projects.title: MONEY
bullets: Built a personal finance dashboard with Next.js and React, using recharts to visualize spending patterns from structured data.
Modeled the underlying PostgreSQL schema for transaction records, tightening field constraints after a bad import produced inconsistent categories.

projects.title: Product
bullets: Developed a Next.js and PostgreSQL application across sustained daily commits, writing PLpgSQL for server-side data logic.
Configured Linux server deployment and access for the app, prompting closer attention to who could reach the database directly.

projects.title: Jungsan
bullets: Built a TypeScript and PLpgSQL program with continuous integration, catching schema regressions before they reached the deployed database.

leadership.title: Regular Member
bullets: After noticing how much financial data her own project stored, started reading about access control and joined a peer security discussion group.
Began treating every new database table as a question of who should be able to read it, not just how to query it.
